The special inspector shall observe, inspect and document the components in their deployed state. Any defects shall be noted. The special inspector shall also review all annual inspection documentation for the preceding three years to confirm its completeness.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
